name: BMF Minigame Events
description: Feeds Omegga-observed Brickadia minigame lifecycle and leaderboard changes into BMF events.
author: BMF

runtimeDir.description: Path to Mods/BMF/runtime for adapter status files. If blank, OMEGGA_BMF_RUNTIME_DIR or the standard Omegga-managed BMF runtime path is used.

bridgePluginName.description: Name of the loaded BMF Bridge plugin used for socket command delivery.

emitJoinEvents.description: Emit joinminigame and leaveminigame events from Brickadia checkpoint logs.

allowUnsafeConsoleSnapshots.description: Opt in to Brickadia GetAll-based minigame/leaderboard snapshots. Disabled by default because this path can crash the current UE4SS dedicated-server runtime.

seedCacheFromBmfData.description: Seed the adapter's join/leave caches from BMF.minigames.data.snapshot at startup and during safe manual syncs.

seedCacheTimeoutMs.description: Timeout while waiting for BMF.minigames.data.snapshot socket responses used for cache seeding.

eventCommandTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for BMF minigame event socket commands sent through BMF Bridge.

snapshotImportTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for BMF minigame snapshot import socket commands sent through BMF Bridge.

emitRoundEvents.description: Emit roundchange and roundend events from BP_Ruleset_C snapshots when allowUnsafeConsoleSnapshots is enabled.

emitSnapshotEvents.description: Emit BMF-native snapshot events when the observed minigame/member/team snapshot changes and allowUnsafeConsoleSnapshots is enabled.

applySnapshotImports.description: Import observed minigame/member/team snapshots into BMF.minigames data with bmf.minigames.data.apply-snapshot when allowUnsafeConsoleSnapshots is enabled.

emitCreateEvents.description: Emit BMF-native created events when a new BP_Ruleset_C appears after the initial snapshot and allowUnsafeConsoleSnapshots is enabled.

emitDeleteEvents.description: Emit BMF-native deleted events when an observed BP_Ruleset_C disappears and allowUnsafeConsoleSnapshots is enabled.

emitTeamEvents.description: Emit BMF-native teamchange events from BP_Team_C MemberStates snapshots when allowUnsafeConsoleSnapshots is enabled.

emitLeaderboardEvents.description: Emit leaderboardchange, score, kill, and death events from BP_PlayerState_C LeaderboardData snapshots when allowUnsafeConsoleSnapshots is enabled.

startupDelayMs.description: Delay after the Omegga server-start event before the first minigame and leaderboard snapshots.

minigameCheckIntervalMs.description: Interval for minigame round snapshots when unsafe console snapshots are enabled. Set to 0 to disable round polling.

leaderboardCheckIntervalMs.description: Interval for leaderboard snapshots when unsafe console snapshots are enabled. Set to 0 to disable leaderboard polling.

minigameCheckTimeoutMs.description: Timeout used while waiting for GetAll BP_Ruleset_C command output.

leaderboardCheckTimeoutMs.description: Timeout used while waiting for GetAll BP_PlayerState_C LeaderboardData command output.

afterMatchDelayMs.description: Delay after the last matching console line before a snapshot resolves.

joinRetryCount.description: Retry count for resolving the Omegga player/minigame cache after a join log.

joinRetryDelayMs.description: Delay between join cache resolution retries.

duplicateJoinWindowMs.description: Window for ignoring duplicate Brickadia checkpoint log lines.
